Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_LockpickingMo: Choose the lockpicking system: Old (simple) or New (with pins).
Sandbox_MultiplierConfig_Lockpicking_too: Rate at which Lockpicking skill levels up. (Works only if 'Use Global Multiplier' is off)
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_DisableCrowba: When enabled, removes the crowbar prying option from this mod. Useful if you use Common Sense or another mod that provides crowbar interactions.
Sandbox_TheBestLockpicking_DisableHotwir: When enabled, disables this mod's hotwire and unhotwire system. Use with mods like Immersive Hotwire for an alternative hotwiring experience.
